title: Ek earthquake ne DIN chhota kar diya
description: Season 2 Episode 19: Angular momentum (mass-spread × spin) is conserved: pull mass inward and spin speeds up — for skaters and for planets.
ncert_chapter: NCERT XI Ch 6 (conservation of angular momentum, L = Iω)
exam_focus: JEE/NEET: skater problem, moment of inertia
hook_text: 2011 earthquake ne din 1.8 microsecond CHHOTA kar diya ⏰
concept: Angular momentum (mass-spread × spin) is conserved: pull mass inward and spin speeds up — for skaters and for planets.
on_screen_cues: "L = I × ω = constant" → skater arms out (I↑ ω↓) / arms in (I↓ ω↑) → "Japan 2011: day −1.8 μs (NASA)" → "NCERT XI Ch 6"
pinned_comment: Agar Earth ki saari barf pighal ke equator ki taraf phail jaaye — din LAMBA hoga ya CHHOTA? 🧊
suggested_titles: "Ek earthquake ne din chhota kar diya 🤯" / "Ice skater tez kyun ghoomti hai? Angular momentum"
elevenlabs_script:
Gudiya: [curious] Chintu, ice skater haath andar karti hai aur achanak super fast ghoomne lagti hai. Koi push nahi... speed kahan se aayi?
Chintu: [excited] Kahin se nahi aayi! Woh pehle se thi. Bas... ikatthi ho gayi.
Gudiya: [confused] Matlab?
Chintu: [cheerfully] Ghoomti hui cheez ka ek hisaab hota hai: ANGULAR MOMENTUM. Mass kitna door hai, into kitni tezi se ghoom raha hai. Yeh hisaab badal nahi sakta!
Gudiya: [thoughtful] Toh haath andar... mass centre ke paas... toh speed?
Chintu: [elated] BADHNI padegi! Hisaab fix hai. Ek cheez kam, doosri zyada!
Gudiya: [surprised] Isliye ghoomti kursi pe haath andar karo toh tez ho jaate ho!
Chintu: [excited] Exactly! Ab Earth ke saath yahi karo.
Gudiya: [confused] Earth ke saath?!
Chintu: [dramatic tone] 2011. Japan earthquake. Zameen ka bhaari hissa thoda andar ki taraf shift hua...
Gudiya: [gasps] Toh Earth tez ghoomi?!
Chintu: [excited] Haan! Din 1 point 8 MICROSECOND chhota ho gaya. NASA ne calculate kiya.
Gudiya: [elated] Matlab pura planet ek ice skater hai?!
Chintu: [laughs] Aur jab tum equator ki taraf jaate ho, tum Earth ko bahut, bahut thoda slow karte ho!
Gudiya: [laughs] Meri wajah se din lamba?!
Chintu: [proudly] Hisaab hisaab hai. Conservation of angular momentum. Billi bhi isse hi ulta girke seedha land karti hai.
Gudiya: [curious] Ek challenge do jo main abhi try karoon!
Chintu: [mischievously] Deewar ke paas jao. Woh next video mein!
